Definition: Ittai or Ithai, the name of a Gittite and of an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Ittai or Ithai = "with me"; 1) a Gittite commander from Gath in David's army; 2) one of David's 30 mighty warriors, a Benjamite
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
